drafts.title: Hypothetical GPU Context Length Slowdown: 2048 vs 8192
drafts.body: I'm investigating a hypothetical performance degradation observed when increasing context length. Specifically, a setup with a 16 GB GPU (F1) shows a noticeable slowdown when the context length is increased from 2048 to 8192 tokens (F2). This is a hypothetical scenario, and no actual measurements have been taken. The goal is to understand potential causes for such a slowdown. We haven't recorded specific model or runtime versions yet (F3), and there's currently no indication of driver, VRAM, or model-specific issues (F4). Could this slowdown be a predictable consequence of increased context length on a 16 GB card, perhaps related to memory bandwidth, attention mechanism scaling, or runtime overhead? Any insights into common bottlenecks in this hypothetical situation would be appreciated.
